# Doravo Core

> Doravo Core is an education management platform built by Doravo. It brings student and staff management, assessments and e-exams, attendance, fees, communication and everyday school operations into one platform.

## Key facts
- Product: Doravo Core (also written "DoravoCore")
- Company: Doravo
- Website: https://www.doravocore.co.ke/
- Demo requests: WhatsApp +254 708 903 949 (preferred) or info@doravocore.co.ke

## What it does
- Online assessments and timed e-exams, with results tied to student records
- Attendance registers by class or subject
- Fees: billing, payments and balances; downloadable invoices and receipts after payment is confirmed
- Gate and visitor logs, kitchen and meal cards, leave-out requests
- Portals for administrators, teachers, students and parents, with each school's own branding
